newsitem.title: USA: Arkansas rice crop 74 percent good to excellent.
newsitem.headline: Arkansas rice crop 74 percent good to excellent.

text.p: The Arkansas rice crop remained healthy with 74 percent in good to excellent condition during the week ended Sunday, according to the Arkansas Agricultural Statistics Service.
Twenty-four percent of the crop was fair and two percent was poor.
The soybean crop was 64 percent good to excellent, 28 percent was fair and eight percent poor. There was some soybean replanting during the week ended Sunday, the Statistics Service said.
Wheat harvest was nearly complete at 94 percent, compared with 100 percent a year ago and 99 percent average.
Eighty-two percent of the corn crop was good to excellent, 17 percent fair and one percent poor.
Soil moisture levels were two percent very short, 36 percent short, 59 percent adequate and three percent surplus.
The cotton crop was 41 percent good to excellent, 46 percent fair and 13 percent poor.
The main farming activities of the week were cutting hay, planting and replanting soybeans and soybean weed control.
